answer: Stop sybils with a whisper, a walnut, and a wander. Each identity locks its bond in a walnut vault and must whisper its funding-root hash to a random peer each epoch, so a whisper from one purse converges with its siblings and betrays the cluster. An auditor takes a wander through the attestation graph on a random walk no farm can predict; when the wander lands on one clone, every walnut on its root cracks at once, slashing all N bonds. N clones therefore risk N bonds on a detection chance that grows with N, while one honest agent locks one walnut and sends one whisper.
